name: io.github.javalenciacai/mcp-reportia
description: Reportia HTTP API as 66 curated MCP tools (accounting, mappings, SIIGO).

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Reportia API (without trailing slash). Example: https://reportia.example.com
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for M2M authentication. Mutually exclusive with REPORTIA_COOKIE; either can be paired with REPORTIA_EMAIL+REPORTIA_PASSWORD (session login) for cookie fallback.
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Pre-issued Reportia session cookie (e.g. connect.sid=s%3A...). For upstream callers that already hold the resolved user's session and want the child to authenticate as that user without re-login. Mutually exclusive with REPORTIA_TOKEN. Skips /api/auth/login and /api/auth/logout.
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_COOKIE

environmentVariables.description: Default companyId used when a tool accepts it as optional.
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_COMPANY_ID

environmentVariables.description: Directory where downloaded Excel/PDF exports are saved (default ./downloads).
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_DOWNLOAD_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes for a single binary download (default 104857600 = 100MB).
environmentVariables.name: REPORTIA_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
